corpus: 250 genuine noVNC file revisions, five-line queries
correctness: all 250 full documents reconstructed byte-exact from compressed pieces; all sampled windows exact
notes: Physical storage includes independent compressed base frames, compressed piece-map per version, and literal data per version.
